what_this_proves: The operator uses the highest semantic control surface it has (UI Automation) from the cloud - invoke, set value, select, read - and no action counts as a success until an independent read says it happened: an invoke whose element neither changed nor went away is a failure, a set value is read back through the tree, a selection from its container; every plan the operator can build ends in a verified postcondition (22/22, asserted structurally). Screenshot understanding sits behind a provider interface that answers honestly when no provider is configured. Application knowledge lives in declared adapters.

red_first_proof.method: Executed mutations, each restored from a sha256-verified backup copy (never `git checkout --`).
mutations: an unchanged element counts as invoked -> 1 failure.
set_value trusts the device without a read-back -> 1 failure.
no provider answers anyway (a fake substituted) -> 1 failure.
the image never reaches the provider -> 1 failure.
the window_gone read always says gone -> 1 failure (the first attempt, disabling the branch, stayed green and was replaced by this one).

runtime_proof.status: PROVEN_REAL (test lab); production command READY_FOR_OWNER; 105 PROVEN_UNVERIFIED until the owner's vision key
runtime_proof.why: REAL_PROOF_REQUIRED is 'PROVEN_REAL — gerçek bir uygulamada UIA ile düğme tetiklendi ve sonuç bağımsız okundu'. On this desktop: an unsaved Notepad was asked to close, the save prompt's button was found through ui.inspect by name, invoked through ui.invoke (element gone by the companion's own read), and the consequence was read independently - the process exited and neither the dialog nor the editor is in window.list. The production half is Karar 0's. Vision: the OpenAI path is exercised against an httpx MockTransport (request shape, key in the header only, transport error named); a real model answer needs the owner's key.
